title: Elecrow AIO
subtitle: 7-inch touchscreen · Wi-Fi
status: SD transfers tested · public display check pending
note: Select the Elecrow All-in-one Starter Kit. Set up Wi-Fi over serial after installation. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B
subtitle: Integrated 7-inch touchscreen · Wi-Fi
note: For the integrated Touch-LCD-7B board. Use its USB-to-UART Type-C port for serial installation and Wi-Fi setup. Requires compatible ESP-Hosted firmware on the C6. Chip revision: 3.

title: ESP32-P4-NANO
subtitle: 10.1-inch touchscreen or HDMI, C6 Wi-Fi or Ethernet
note: Select the display fitted to your NANO. The 10.1-inch JD9365/GT911 profile uses onboard C6 Wi-Fi and the panel I2C power controller at 0x45. HDMI profiles require the EBYTE ECA20-MHA1-I (GSV1172) with two-lane input and a correctly wired adapter. HDMI 720p/1080p use Ethernet; nano-wifi uses C6 Wi-Fi. Audio uses the board codec; HDMI audio is not configured. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build. All NANO profiles are untested.

title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6
subtitle: 7-inch DSI touchscreen · Wi-Fi
note: For ESP32-P4-WIFI6 with the original 7-inch 1024 × 600 DSI panel. The 7B panel needs a different configuration. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-ETH
subtitle: HDMI monitor or TV, Ethernet
note: 32MB flash, IP101 Ethernet and ECA20-MHA1-I bridge. Correct adapter wiring and two-lane bridge input required. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4B
subtitle: 4-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: 720x720 ST7703 and GT911. Confirm the hosted C6 wiring against the exact PCB schematic: the supplied example and vendor signal summary differ. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: Tab5 (original screen revision)
subtitle: 5-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: Original ILI9881C display and GT911 touch only. ST7123/ST7121 revisions need another profile. Programming uses USB Serial/JTAG. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build. To enter download mode, hold RESET for about two seconds until the green LED flashes, then release it.

title: JC1060P470
subtitle: 7-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: 1024x600 panel, GT911 and ES8311 audio. SD power uses LDO4 passthrough. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: JC4880P443C_I_W
subtitle: 4.3-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: 480x800 ST7701 with GT911. Touch reset GPIO3 and SD LDO4 follow the board BSP. Fixed-size apps need individual testing on the smaller canvas. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: JC8012P4A1
subtitle: 10.1-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: 800x1280 JD9365 with the pinned GSL3680 touch driver. Touch orientation and all peripherals need hardware validation. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-M3-Dev
subtitle: HDMI monitor or TV, Wi-Fi
note: Bare M3 board with the ECA20-MHA1-I bridge, not an unspecified DSI panel. Requires a correctly wired adapter. USB Serial/JTAG programming. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board
subtitle: 7-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi
note: v1.5.2 with supplied 7-inch EK79007 and GT911. LCD adapter reset/PWM jumpers go to GPIO27/26. This is not the P4X rev3 board. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: ESP32-P4-DevKit
subtitle: HDMI monitor or TV, Ethernet
note: PCB rev D1 with IP101 Ethernet. Requires ECA20-MHA1-I HDMI bridge and a correctly wired adapter. The Olimex LT8912 MIPI-HDMI adapter needs its own driver configuration. USB host wiring is on the expansion header. No onboard Wi-Fi or speaker. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.

title: FireBeetle 2 ESP32-P4 (DFR1172)
subtitle: HDMI monitor or TV, Wi-Fi
note: DFR1172 ESP32-P4 model only. Requires ECA20-MHA1-I bridge and a correctly wired adapter. C6 Wi-Fi and SD are configured. Its PDM microphone is not speaker hardware, so audio output is omitted. Use a powered USB hub for USB inputs. Chip revision: 0/1; production rev3 needs a separate build.
